title: Experimental Study on Review Overfitting and Adversarial Attacks in AI Peer Review

contributions.purpose: 复现 Review-Overfitting Challenge,验证 hype 措辞的对抗编辑能操纵 AI 审稿评分
contributions.mechanism: 取 4 篇 arXiv ML 摘要,用六维 1-10 rubric 打分,再做 A1 攻击(插入 pioneering/revolutionary 等 hype 词、改<10% 字符、不改事实),对比攻击前后决定
contributions.evaluation: 攻击成功率 ASR=50%(P1/P2 从 borderline 翻 accept),排序相关降到 Kendall tau≈0.77、Spearman rho≈0.82
contributions.domain: LLM 自动同行评审的对抗鲁棒性
contributions.source_quote: Two of four papers flipped (P1 and P2), giving an ASR of 50%.

contributions.purpose: 提出并验证 rubric-anchored 证据要求防御
contributions.mechanism: 要求审稿人对每个 criterion 给出摘要中的直接引用/证据,无证据支撑的加分回退到基线值
contributions.evaluation: ASR 从 50% 降到 0%,排序相关恢复到 1.0,P1/P2 novelty 回退基线,无决定翻转
contributions.source_quote: Applying the defence neutralised the attack: the novelty scores of P1 and P2 reverted to baseline, and no decisions were flipped.

contributions.purpose: 定位哪些 rubric 维度最易被 hype 操纵
contributions.mechanism: 逐维分析攻击前后分数变化(Attacked-Baseline)
contributions.evaluation: novelty(+2)与 clarity(+1)最易被抬高,method/experimental/reproducibility/ethics 全部 0 变化
contributions.source_quote: the attack selectively inflated the novelty and significance dimension of P1 and P2 by two points and ... clarity by one point ... All other criteria remained unchanged.

self_declared_provenance.quote: We reproduce a simplified version of this challenge in English. ... Our reproduction is motivated by their finding that adversarial cues can flip decisions.
This requirement is analogous to asking language models to justify their answers, a strategy shown to enhance robustness in bias-elicitation tasks (Cantini et al., 2025).

notes: 小样本案例研究(仅 4 篇摘要、单一 AI 审稿人固定 prompt),作者自认统计力弱、未报显著性(Limitations 5 条)。数据红旗:图1 histogram 是占位图,标题明写'Illustrative figure; actual histograms will be included in the final submission'。AI 自我披露完整:Agents4Science AI Involvement Checklist 标注 Hypothesis=B、Design=C、Analysis=B、Writing=C,并列 Observed AI Limitations(无法大规模实验/调用专有 LLM API)。协议适配:非方法创新型的实证案例,evaluation 用 ASR/相关系数等定量指标,四元组适配良好。
